sectionTitle: ÔN TẬP PHẦN 4 · SẮP XẾP CÂU - SENTENCE ORDERING
sectionDesc: Bộ đề HOMEWORK môn Anh Văn - Phần 4. Phần này: sắp xếp các câu (A–D) theo thứ tự đúng để tạo thành một đoạn văn hoàn chỉnh.

questions.question:
A. In addition, reading improves your vocabulary and concentration.
B. Reading books is a great way to broaden your knowledge.
C. Therefore, you should make reading a daily habit.
D. It helps you understand the world and people better.

Choose the correct order of the sentences.

A. This habit also makes revision before exams much easier.
B. Taking notes in class can help students remember lessons better.
C. As a result, students who take notes often perform better.
D. For example, they can write down important points and key ideas.

Choose the correct order of the sentences.

A. In addition, recycling saves natural resources like water and energy.
B. Recycling is important for protecting the environment.
C. It helps reduce the amount of waste sent to landfills.
D. Therefore, everyone should recycle regularly.

Choose the correct order of the sentences.

A. For example, they can use the quiet morning to review their lessons.
B. Waking up early has many benefits for students.
C. In addition, they have more time to get ready without rushing.
D. Therefore, students should try to wake up early every day.

Choose the correct order of the sentences.

A. In addition, teamwork teaches people how to listen and communicate well.
B. Working in a team helps people solve problems faster.
C. Each member can bring different skills and ideas.
D. As a result, good teamwork often leads to better results.

Choose the correct order of the sentences.

A. In addition, songs make it easier to remember vocabulary.
B. Listening to English songs is a fun way to improve your English.
C. It helps you learn new words and natural pronunciation.
D. Therefore, you should listen to English music regularly.

Choose the correct order of the sentences.

A. In addition, it can improve their reading and thinking skills.
B. Reading the news helps people understand what is happening around them.
C. It keeps them updated on important events and social issues.
D. Therefore, students should read the news every day.

Choose the correct order of the sentences.

A. For example, they can cover medical bills or urgent repairs.
B. Saving money is an important habit for everyone.
C. It helps people prepare for unexpected expenses.
D. As a result, they feel more secure about the future.

Choose the correct order of the sentences.

A. For example, water helps carry nutrients and remove waste.
B. Drinking enough water is essential for good health.
C. It helps the body function properly every day.
D. Therefore, you should drink water regularly throughout the day.

Choose the correct order of the sentences.

A. However, they can also distract students from their lessons.
B. Smartphones can be very useful at school.
C. Students can use them to search for information quickly.
D. Therefore, students should use them wisely.

Choose the correct order of the sentences.

A. You can choose fresh ingredients and control the amount of salt.
B. Cooking at home is usually healthier than eating out.
C. In addition, cooking at home can save you money.
D. Therefore, you should try to cook more meals at home.

Choose the correct order of the sentences.

A. This also helps them develop confidence in speaking.
B. Group discussions help students understand lessons more deeply.
C. They can exchange ideas and learn from each other.
D. As a result, group work is very valuable in class.

Choose the correct order of the sentences.

A. For example, you can walk to nearby places instead of taking a car.
B. Walking instead of driving is good for both health and the environment.
C. It helps you stay active and reduce air pollution.
D. Therefore, people should walk more often.

Choose the correct order of the sentences.

A. In addition, achieving small goals builds their confidence.
B. Setting goals helps students achieve academic success.
C. Clear goals give them direction and motivation.
D. Therefore, students should set both short-term and long-term goals.

Choose the correct order of the sentences.

A. In addition, studying together keeps everyone motivated.
B. Learning English with friends can make studying more fun.
C. They can practice speaking and correct each other's mistakes.
D. Therefore, finding a good study partner is a helpful idea.
